known_for.title: Becoming Water
known_for.overview: A girl saves money during the holidays to buy a panda and takes care of her family's prayer shrine when she notices that a Buddha statue has disappeared.

known_for.title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
known_for.original_title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
known_for.overview: In the 28th century, Valerian and Laureline are special operatives charged with keeping order throughout the human territories. On assignment from the Minister of Defense, the two undertake a mission to Alpha, an ever-expanding metropolis where species from across the universe have converged over centuries to share knowledge, intelligence, and cultures. At the center of Alpha is a mysterious dark force which threatens the peaceful existence of the City of a Thousand Planets, and Valerian and Laureline must race to identify the menace and safeguard not just Alpha, but the future of the universe.

known_for.title: The Fountain
known_for.overview: Spanning over one thousand years, and three parallel stories, The Fountain is a story of love, death, spirituality, and the fragility of our existence in this world.

results.title: Mystery of Muye: The Guardian of the Mountain
results.overview: During the period of the Republic of China, the reclusive descendants of Guanshan Taibao were ordered to investigate a case and solve the mystery of the "Nine Pavilions" of the Qianji Ancient Palace hidden under the mine disaster.
